# komodo_procedure (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo procedure by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_procedure" "backup" {
  id = "backup-core-database" # ID or procedure name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Procedure ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `schedule` (String) Schedule expression. Empty when the procedure has no schedule.
- `schedule_enabled` (Boolean)
- `schedule_format` (String) English or Cron.
- `schedule_timezone` (String)
- `stage_names` (List of String) Names of the procedure's stages, in run order.
- `webhook_enabled` (Boolean)
